title: Fateful Choice
next_chapter_hook: "Just as Chen Ji thought the negotiation had succeeded, the Fourth Page of the Tianji Record suddenly burned searing hot, and a rune he had never seen before emerged—the first seal left by the founder of Tianji Pavilion. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang from the Void, no longer with the amicable demeanor from before, but carrying a bone-piercing chill: 'You think you have the qualification to negotiate terms?'"

text.content: "The night wind cut like a blade, slicing through the silence of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Chen Ji sat alone atop a massive boulder at the Cliff Edge, the torn page of the Tianji Record in his palm emanating a诡异 bronze-colored glow. Mo Xiansheng had departed three days ago, but the words 'Chapter 700's death prophecy has been altered' coiled in his Mental Sea like a venomous snake, and whenever he closed his eyes, that blurry number appeared—700, a death date he would eventually face. The sound of patrolling disciples' footsteps echoed from afar, and he instinctively tucked the torn page into his sleeve, though his fingertips trembled slightly."

"Heavenly Fate Value: 87. This was all his current筹码. Every increase and decrease of each number concerned life and death, and tonight, the seal on the Fourth Page of the Tianji Record was loosening. Mo Xiansheng had said that the complete four pages of the Tianji Record would grant him the ability to glimpse within seven days, but the price was—becoming an official member of Tianji Pavilion. From then on, his will would no longer belong to himself."

dialogue.content: "(The fragmented soul within the Tianji Record quivered slightly; Mo Xiansheng's aged voice sounded from the Void) 'You've come, three days earlier than I anticipated.' The fragmented soul's form flickered in the moonlight, 'It seems you've made your choice.'"

text.content: Chen Ji offered no answer; his gaze fell upon the location of the Fourth Page. Where there had once been a chaotic gray mist, faint golden patterns now emerged, as if some ancient contractual rune was awakening. He drew a deep breath, his voicecalm得近乎cold："Mo Xiansheng, I wish to know one thing—if I refuse to become a member of Tianji Pavilion, what will happen to this Fourth Page?"

dialogue.content: "(Mo Xiansheng let out a low laugh, though it carried an indescribable melancholy) 'Refuse?' He approached slowly, the fragmented soul leaving a trail of eerie blue light points, 'Then this page will sleep forever, and you—will forever be unable to decipher Chapter 700's death prophecy. You will become the only piece on this chessboard unaware of its own fate.'"

text.content: The words were uttered lightly, yet they plunged Chen Ji's heart into the abyss. He thought of his younger sister Chen Nian, taken away by the Holy Sect, and that blurry prophetic vision—Chen Nian's face forever obscured, as if fate had deliberately left this迷雾. If he couldn't glimpse further into the future, how could he find her? How could he break that damnable Chapter 700? The abyss below the cliff sent back echoing sounds, as if mocking his hesitation.

But he didn't immediately agree. Memories of his previous life's workplace struggles taught him that the heavens never drop free lunches, and the more tempting the conditions, the sharper the blade hidden behind them. He raised his head, staring directly at that mass of eerie blue fragmented soul: "What do members of Tianji Pavilion need to do? I want to see the specific terms."

dialogue.content: "(Mo Xiansheng seemed surprised by his composure; the fragmented soul solidified slightly) 'You are more cautious than any inheritor I've encountered.' His tone carried a hint of approval, 'Members of Tianji Pavilion must fulfill three obligations: First, obey Tianji Pavilion's dispatch and execute designated missions; second, never reveal the existence of Tianji Pavilion to anyone; third, when destiny's nodes arrive, take the Tianji Record's guidance as the supreme will.'"

text.content: Three obligations, each word like a nail. Chen Ji's pupils contracted—obey dispatch, keep secrets, take the Tianji Record's guidance as supreme will. This meant he would彻底成为 Tianji Pavilion's blade. Recalling Mo Xiansheng's always elusive manner, recalling that Tianji Pavilion constantly hidden behind the scenes, he suddenly realized: perhaps this was never a benevolent organization at all, but a fate machine that had been operating for who knows how many ten thousands of years.

choice.prompt: Faced with these three近乎苛刻的条件, Chen Ji must make his choice. His next action will determine the direction of his fate.

choices.description: Accept the complete Prophet's inheritance, become an official member of Tianji Pavilion, gain the ability to glimpse seven days, but from then on be at the mercy of others.
choices.visible_cost: Lose partial autonomy, must obey Tianji Pavilion's dispatch
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete four pages of Tianji Record, foresight of seven days ability, reduced Heavenly Fate consumption
choices.risk_hint: May become Tianji Pavilion's chess piece, execute tasks against one's true intentions

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his fingers gently stroking the seal on the Fourth Page. The bronze glow instantly softened, as if some ancient welcoming ceremony. Mo Xiansheng let out a satisfied sigh: 'A wise choice. From this day forward, you are the seventeenth generation Prophet of Tianji Pavilion.' Before the words finished, the Fourth Page suddenly unfolded, golden contractual runes surging into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a tide—pain, pain deep into the marrow, as if someone was forcibly modifying his soul's烙印.

choices.description: Refuse to become a member of Tianji Pavilion, maintain freedom, but never decipher the death prophecy, and may anger Tianji Pavilion.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the foresight of seven days ability, Chapter 700 prophecy forever remains a mystery
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independence and autonomy, unbound by Tianji Pavilion
choices.risk_hint: Tianji Pavilion may regard you as a threat, future cooperation opportunities forfeited

text.content: Chen Ji rose abruptly, cold light flickering in his sleeve—he didn't even know when he had drawn the dagger. The dagger pressed against the seal of the Fourth Page, his voice cold as millennium-old glacial ice: "I refuse. Tianji Pavilion's will has nothing to do with me." Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul suddenly solidified, and a dangerous glint flashed in those illusory eyes: "Do you know what you're saying? One who refuses Tianji Pavilion—" He didn't finish, but the suddenly凝聚压迫感 in the air had already explained everything.

choices.description: Proposing additional conditions: retaining partial autonomy, only accepting missions related to finding his sister, refusing meaningless task executions.
choices.visible_cost: Negotiations take time and may provoke Mo Xiansheng.
choices.visible_reward: Maintaining certain autonomy to preserve freedom of action for finding Chen Nian.
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Pavilion may refuse negotiations or propose harsher counter-conditions.

text.content: Chen Ji neither drew his blade nor retreated. He sheathed the dagger back into his sleeve and instead wore a meaningful smile: "Mo Xiansheng, you said I am the most cautious among all inheritors through the ages—then you should also know that I will never make a move without seeing the full picture of the chessboard." His voice was unhurried, "Three obligations, I can accept, but I also have three conditions." Mo Xiansheng's eyes narrowed slightly, and the light around his remnant soul softened: "Speak."

Mo Xiansheng's form drifted gently under the moonlight, the remnant soul's outline glowing brighter with anticipation. As the guardian of the Tianji Record, he had witnessed too many inheritors lose their reason before fate—greedy ones, fearful ones, desperate ones, each different. But this young man before him, when facing a choice that could alter his destiny, still managed to remain so composed, even attempting to negotiate terms. This reminded Mo Xiansheng of the first Pavilion Master of the Tianji Pavilion—that man who also defied conventional wisdom. He decided to give Chen Ji a chance, though this was beyond his duties.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng stands with hands behind his back, the light around his remnant soul flickering) "Three conditions?" His tone carried a hint of playfulness, "You certainly have big appetite. However—" he shifted gears, "this old man is interested in hearing what these three conditions are. If reasonable, the Tianji Pavilion may show flexibility; if unreasonable..." He didn't finish, but the invisible pressure caused gravel at the cliff's edge to tumble down.

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath. He knew he was walking a tightrope—too fast and he'd fall into the abyss, too slow and he'd lose balance. But his countless experiences in business negotiations from his previous life taught him: the one who dares to speak always gets more than the one who only nods. He raised his first finger: "First, I accept the Tianji Pavilion's missions, but if a mission relates to finding my sister Chen Nian, I have the right to execute it first. In other words, the Tianji Pavilion cannot prevent me from searching for her."

Mo Xiansheng's eyes flickered, not interrupting him. Chen Ji raised his second finger: "Second, when I have doubts about a certain prophecy, I have the right to request the Tianji Pavilion provide the original records. This is not leaking Tianji Pavilion secrets, but—" he paused, choosing a precise word, "audit rights. You have played this chess game for tens of thousands of years; I at least need to know if the rules are fair." This time, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul visibly trembled.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's voice gained a layer of complexity) "Audit rights... Do you know what you're asking for? This means you will see the failure cases of all prophecy readers through the ages, see the Tianji Pavilion's past decision mistakes, even—" he paused, "see certain truths deliberately concealed." Chen Ji met his gaze without retreating: "What I want to see are precisely those concealed truths. The prophecy in Chapter Seven Hundred was tampered with once. I want to know who changed it and why."

text.content: The moment these words fell, the air at the cliff's edge seemed to freeze. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul solidified abruptly, and for the first time, genuine shock appeared in those illusory eyes—not acted, truly moved. "How do you know about the prophecy being tampered with?" His voice dropped lower, "This matter... this old man never told you." A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips, carrying a smile of three parts triumph and three parts mockery: "Mo Xiansheng, you just said I am the most cautious among all inheritors—then you should also know that a fool's ears are never deaf."

These words were light, yet caused Mo Xiansheng to fall silent for a full three breaths. After three breaths, he let out a low laugh, containing a kind of indescribable appreciation: "Good, good, good!" He said three good words in succession, "This old man is increasingly convinced you are the one selected by the Tianji Record." The remnant soul drifted closer to Chen Ji, the ethereal blue light almost touching his face, "What is your third condition?" Chen Ji raised his third finger: "Third, retain the right to withdraw. If one day I find the Tianji Pavilion's will conflicts with my bottom line, I must be able to—leave."

choice.prompt: Three conditions have been proposed, Mo Xiansheng needs time to consider. During this period, Chen Ji can take further actions to increase his negotiating leverage.

choices.description: Maintaining silence, giving Mo Xiansheng space to think. No more pressure, retreating to advance.
choices.visible_cost: May be pressured during the waiting period
choices.visible_reward: Demonstrating grace, giving the other party room to step back.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may take this opportunity to propose counter-conditions.

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his fingers, standing with hands behind his back. The moonlight stretched his shadow long, casting it toward the abyss below the cliff. He spoke no more, simply waiting quietly. Silence is a weapon—it forces the other party to fill the void with their own thoughts, and gives oneself time to observe every micro-expression of the opponent. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted gently in the moonlight, like a lamp about to extinguish. After a long while, he spoke: "This old man needs to report your conditions to the Tianji Pavilion's Council of Elders. But—" his voice became meaningful, "this old man can give you a temporary reply."

choices.description: Displaying his bargaining chips: if negotiations break down, he will make the Tianji Pavilion's existence public, creating an uncontrollable situation.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may resort to coercive measures

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly let out a light laugh, that laughter sounding especially jarring in the silent cliffside: "Mo Xiansheng, I advise you to think carefully before answering." He leisurely took a jade slip from his sleeve, "This contains all the anomalies I have observed over these years—the Tianji Record's fluctuations, the timing patterns of your appearances, and—" he deliberately paused, "the Tianji Pavilion's covert layouts in the various major sects. If I cannot walk out of this mountain tonight, these things will automatically spread throughout the three great sects." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul froze instantly, and for the first time, genuine killing intent appeared in those illusory eyes.

Mo Xiansheng said nothing. The Soul Remnant's surrounding light fluctuated violently, as if engaged in some intense inner struggle. Chen Ji's words had struck his vital point—Tianji Bureau had been able to remain hidden for countless years precisely because no one had ever possessed such a complete chain of evidence. Once this information leaked, Tianji Bureau would face a joint encirclement and suppression from the three great sects and the entire cultivation world. The silence lasted for a very long time, long enough that the night birds at the cliff's base were startled, flapping away into the distant darkness. Finally, Mo Xiansheng spoke, his voice hoarse as if scraped by sandpaper: "I agree to two and a half of your conditions, old man."

"Two and a half?" Chen Ji's brow slightly raised—this phrasing was interesting. Mo Xiansheng continued: "First, regarding your sister—Tianji Bureau will not prevent you from searching for her, and may even provide partial clues. However, if a mission is related to her, you must report to the Elder Council." Chen Ji did not interrupt, gesturing for him to continue. "Second, the audit rights—" Mo Xiansheng's tone became extraordinarily grave. "I can grant you viewing permissions, but you can only look, not take anything. Moreover, certain core secrets concerning Tianji Bureau's survival remain closed to you." He paused. "As for the third condition..." The Soul Remnant's eyes stared directly at Chen Ji. "I can only say—I will try my best to争取 for you."

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's voice lowered, as if stating some irreversible fate) "Tianji Bureau has never granted withdrawal rights to anyone. But—" he pivoted. "I can offer you an alternative method. If you truly discover that Tianji Bureau's will conflicts with your bottom line, you may apply for 'Sealed Inheritance.' At that time, the Tianji Record will enter a dormant state, your Heavenly Fate Value will cease consumption, but you will also lose all prophetic abilities. Until—" he paused. "Until you complete a designated mission, it cannot be reactivated."

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. Was this a trap, or an opportunity? He calculated rapidly in his mind: Sealing the inheritance meant temporarily losing abilities, but if the mission was simple enough, it would be an excellent strategy of retreating to advance. The problem was—who would define the "designated mission"? What if Tianji Bureau deliberately set an impossible task? His fingers tapped lightly in his sleeve—that was his habitual action when thinking. Mo Xiansheng seemed to see through his concerns, letting out a meaningful sigh: "I know what you're worried about. How about this—during the sealing period, your sister's safety will be Tianji Bureau's responsibility."

The words were like a stone dropped into a calm lake, stirring层层涟漪. Chen Nian—his sister who had been missing for years, taken by the Holy Sect as a "Heavenly Fate Lock Key." Her existence interfered with the Tianji Record's foresight; any image containing her was blurred. This was his greatest weakness and his deepest obsession. If Tianji Bureau was willing to guarantee her... "Are you sure?" His voice unconsciously hardened. "My sister is in the Holy Sect's hands. How does Tianji Bureau plan to protect her?" Mo Xiansheng smiled, that smile carrying a spine-chilling depth: "Did you think Tianji Bureau has no layout within the Holy Sect?"

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's implication made Chen Ji realize that Tianji Bureau's reach extended far deeper than he had imagined. In this game of chess, he needed to decide his final stance.

choices.description: Accept Mo Xiansheng's compromise proposal: two and a half conditions plus sister safety guarantee, officially become a member of Tianji Bureau.
choices.visible_cost: Must still obey most of Tianji Bureau's directives, and be controlled by others during the sealing period
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete inheritance, guarantee sister's safety, retain certain autonomy
choices.risk_hint: Tianji Bureau's "protection" may have ulterior motives; must always remain vigilant

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and took a deep breath. When he opened them again, his gaze held a new resolve: "Deal." The two words were spoken lightly yet weighed like a thousand pounds. Mo Xiansheng's Soul Remnant finally completely solidified; those illusory eyes revealed complex light—appreciation, anticipation, and something indescribably pitiful. He extended his hand, ethereal blue light gathering in his palm: "Since it's so, let us complete the final ritual." Chen Ji did not hesitate, reaching out to clasp his hand. Bronze light instantly enveloped his entire body as the fourth page of the Tianji Record dramatically unfolded in his Mental Sea—at that moment, he saw all possibilities within seven days.

choices.memory_label: 陈机正式成为天机阁第十七代预言者，通过谈判保留了部分自主权。

choices.description: Do not accept any compromise, leave with the existing incomplete inheritance, and seek methods to break the death prophecy on your own.
choices.visible_cost: Forever lose complete inheritance; sister's safety cannot be guaranteed
choices.visible_reward: Maintain absolute freedom, unconstrained by any faction
choices.risk_hint: Face the seventh hundred chapter's death fate alone, without any assistance

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hand and stepped back. His movements were slow, yet conveyed undeniable firmness: "I'm sorry, Mo Xiansheng. I cannot leave my sister's fate in anyone's hands—even Tianji Bureau's." Mo Xiansheng's Soul Remnant abruptly dimmed; those illusory eyes revealed obvious disappointment: "Do you know, this is your only chance?" Chen Ji smiled, that smile carrying a hint of bitterness: "I know. But in this life—" his voice suddenly lowered. "What I hate most is handing my fate to others." With that, he turned toward the stone steps at the cliff's edge, his silhouette appearing especially lonely under the moonlight. Behind him, Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded lingeringly: "You will regret this."

choices.description: On the basis of existing conditions, demand that Mo Xiansheng first provide partial clues about Chen Nian's whereabouts as a show of sincerity.
choices.visible_cost: May anger Mo Xiansheng, causing negotiations to break down
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key clues about Chen Nian, accelerate rescue plan
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may think you're pushing your luck and withdraw all promises

text.content: Chen Ji did not withdraw his hand, nor did he continue approaching. He stared directly at Mo Xiansheng's illusory eyes, his voicecalm得像是在讨论天气: "Mo Xiansheng, I see your sincerity. But—" he pivoted. "Words alone are not enough proof. You say Tianji Bureau has layout in the Holy Sect, that you can guarantee my sister's safety. Then, give me a bit of sincerity first?" Mo Xiansheng's eyes narrowed: "What sincerity do you want?" Chen Ji's lips slightly curved: "About Chen Nian's whereabouts—even just a direction, a hint. Let me know that you truly have that capability." The Soul Remnant was silent for a moment, then suddenly let out a low laugh: "Very well, I'll give you a bit of sincerity."

Just as Chen Ji thought the negotiations were successful, the fourth page of the Tianji Record suddenly burned scorching hot. A rune he had never seen before appeared in his Mental Sea—ancient beyond comparison, even more ancient than the Tianji Record itself. Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly changed, no longer the affable manner from before but carrying bone-deep coldness: "Did you think you had the qualifications to negotiate conditions?" Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. The Tianji Record in his palm began to vibrate violently; within the bronze light, a trace of blood-red hue faintly emerged. He realized—he had triggered some mechanism that should never have been triggered. Mo Xiansheng's figure began to distort; beneath that aged face, a face he had never seen emerged—the face of Tianji Bureau's Founder, cold, authoritative, devoid of any emotion.

The night wind at the cliff's edge suddenly ceased, as if even heaven and earth held their breath at this moment. Chen Ji stared at that face, both unfamiliar and familiar, his heart's alarm blaring. He rapidly replayed every detail of what had just transpired—where had things gone wrong? Was it because the negotiation terms were too harsh? Or did that phrase "audit rights" touch upon some forbidden territory that shouldn't have been disturbed? Or perhaps... from the very beginning, this was a trap? Mo Xiansheng's appearance, his yielding, his praise—were they all meticulously designed bait? His back was already soaked with cold sweat, yet his expression remained as calm as still water. This was his greatest advantage: no matter how tumultuous the waves within his heart, his exterior would never be disturbed by ripples.

That cold, indifferent face spoke, its voice seeming to drift from the abyss of the Nine Underworlds: "Throughout the ages, every inheritor has accepted the will of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion with trembling caution, walking on eggshells. Only you—" Its gaze fell upon Chen Ji, carrying the manner of a predator examining its prey, "Only you dared to bargain here." Chen Ji remained silent, but his fingers within his sleeve secretly touched the Jade Slip—the leverage he used to threaten Mo Xiansheng. If even Mo Xiansheng was merely a puppet, would this Jade Slip still be of any use? Just as he contemplated his strategy, a flash of imagery suddenly streaked through his Mental Sea—information transmitted from the fourth page of the Tianji Record, vague and fragmented, yet causing his pupils to contract sharply: In the vision, Chen Nian stood upon a massive altar, her body wrapped in countless golden chains—the power of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key was being extracted. And behind her, a blurred figure watched her intently...

Chen Ji's breathing suddenly became ragged. This was the Tianji Record warning him—if he didn't accept the inheritance now, Chen Nian would die. This realization struck like a basin of ice water over his head, instantly clearing his mind. He could disregard his own fate, could ignore the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's schemes, could不在乎 the death prophecy in Chapter Seven Hundred—but he could not disregard Chen Nian. She was his only blood relative in this world, the only warm bond he felt after transmigrating to this realm. His fingers within his sleeve trembled once, then—slowly released the Jade Slip. He raised his head, gazing at that cold, indifferent face, his voice hoarse yet resolute: "...I accept." The moment those three words left his lips, the fourth page of the Tianji Record burst open, golden contractual runes surged into his Mental Sea like a tide, drowning out all his resistance, all his scheming, all his pride...
